referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the material use for the manufacturing of the sanitary installations in office buildings according to Klingler and Kasser, 2011. The warm water production is not part of this data set. No kitchen equipment other than the sink are considered. 2 office building were analyzed. The sanitary system has a life-span of 30 years. Transport is included. The average energy reference area is 3590 m2.
